name: Collimate

modes.label: On-demand
modes.note: Billed per second on CPU and memory a sandbox holds while live (pricing page example: 1 vCPU/2 GB = ~$0.064/h). Sandbox size is fixed by the template: the create API (CreateSandboxRequest) has no vCPU/RAM parameter and per-template sizes/max sizes are not published. Docs meter 'CPU-core-hours' while the site prices per vCPU-hour. Running disk is metered (Disk-GB-hours) at an unpublished rate. Forks share parent RAM copy-on-write; whether RAM billing is nominal or resident pages is not stated. Spawn and fork are free; no minimum billed time stated.

plans.name: Demo
plans.note: Free, no card, no dollar credits: 2 concurrent sandboxes, 1-hour max session, shared capacity and shared request-rate cap; no outbound network (in-guest only), no inbound connect-url, catalog templates only (no BYO image). Fork group up to 1,000. Usage metered but priced $0.

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: Usage-based; up to 100 concurrent sandboxes, 24-hour sessions (pricing page 2026-09-28).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Custom, invoiced (sales). Pricing page and limits docs state unlimited concurrency and session length (API applies no cap); dedicated nodes, SSO, BYOC, SLA. Live-fork per-call count 64.

caveats: Public list pricing. Demo is free; Pro pays allocated live resources per second. Live fork and spawn are free. Suspend retains full memory and filesystem state.

Features set to null were not verified. No sandbox was purchased or tested; feature/performance statements are documentation claims. Null maximums are unknown unless a cited note explicitly states unlimited.
A complete monthly bill requires known snapshot/egress/plan limits; do not silently treat missing ancillary charges as free.

Re-checked 2026-09-28 (collimate.ai/pricing, docs llms.txt): only vCPU $0.040/h, RAM $0.012/GB-h and suspended storage $0.10/GB-month are published. Running-disk size/price, egress price, SSH and desktop/browser support are not documented (left null).
Running disk is metered (Disk-GB-hours while running) but no rate or per-sandbox disk size is published; estimate omits it.

Request rate is 'per-tenant, high' on Pro (no number published); exceeding it returns 429 rate_limited. Live-fork per call capped at 32 children on Pro, 64 on Enterprise (chunk with fork_group). Exec timeout_seconds <= 3600.
Sessions over the tier max (Demo 1 h, Pro 24 h) are reaped (deleted), not paused; suspend before the cap.

Operator/billing: Collimate is operated by Gero Consulting (Israeli sole proprietorship); Paddle is Merchant of Record; prices may exclude tax; usage non-refundable; metered rates may change prospectively without the 30-day notice that applies to recurring fees.

Docs pricing page, auth tiers table and Refund Policy mention a monthly Pro base fee (amount unpublished); the marketing pricing page says 'no platform fee'. Treat Pro fee as uncertain (possible hidden floor).

fleet.verification: Demo email signup mints a tenant-scoped key; no card.
fleet.tiers: Demo 2; Pro pricing page 100; Enterprise unlimited via sales.
fleet.notes: Pricing page says Pro up to 100 but lifecycle docs say Pro/Enterprise have no concurrency limit: unresolved conflict. Use 2 for new demo account, not 100. 50 fits both descriptions; 300/1,000 on Pro need confirmation. Suspended machines free slots.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

snapshot_auto.quote: Session duration — a sandbox that outlives your tier's max session is reaped. Persist anything you need and re-create, or suspend before the cap.
snapshot_auto.note: Hitting the session cap (Demo 1 h, Pro 24 h) deletes the sandbox; no idle auto-suspend is documented (suspend is an explicit API call). Sandbox state exposes idle_secs but no auto-suspend setting.

snapshot_on_demand.quote: Suspend freezes a running sandbox to disk: its running guest process is snapshotted, its RAM is reclaimed, and its network is released — but the sandbox is fully resumable by id.
snapshot_on_demand.note: POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/suspend; memory included ('exact process memory and filesystem'); resumes in place (1:1). New machines come from live fork (POST .../fork, N copy-on-write children keeping process memory, parent keeps running) or from baked templates ('booted, warmed, checkpointed'); no API to turn a suspended snapshot into a template.

harness_api.note: The full /v1 surface is templates, sandboxes, exec, fork, connect-url/connect, suspend/resume, usage - no agent/prompt/session endpoints. Hosted MCP (mcp.collimate.ai) lets an outside agent such as Claude Code USE sandboxes as tools; that is the reverse direction, not a harness API.

egress_allowlist.quote: default-deny allowlist; metadata endpoint always blocked.
egress_allowlist.note: egress {allow: [hosts]} per create or per exec (overrides template default), per-branch in fork trees; cloud metadata 169.254.169.254 always blocked. Only net/browser templates have a NIC; pure code templates have no network; Demo has no outbound network. IP/CIDR entries not documented (schema is 'Opaque per-sandbox egress policy').

ingress_rules.quote: Mint a signed, time-boxed URL to a port inside a running sandbox — the connect-from-outside primitive.
ingress_rules.note: Pro/Enterprise only; token HMAC-scoped to (tenant, sandbox, port, exp), revoked on delete; only the template's exposed ports (else 409 port_not_exposed); WebSocket tunnel (tcp or cdp) or Bearer key. No public URLs, no IP allowlists.

nested_virt.quote: Every sandbox is a hardware-isolated Firecracker microVM.
nested_virt.note: not offered: no /dev/kvm, VM, or emulator capability is documented anywhere in the API/exec/templates docs; outside the scope of a short-lived Firecracker microVM built for code exec and browser rollouts.

desktop.note: not offered: the only GUI-adjacent surface is a headless Chromium reached via CDP; no VNC/RDP/streamed desktop is documented.

computer_use.quote: Point a local Playwright at that URL with connect_over_cdp. The script runs on your machine; every navigation and selector is executed by the browser inside the sandbox.
computer_use.note: not offered: browser control is via CDP/Playwright selectors, not a screenshot+click computer-use API; outside the product's scope.

anti_bot.quote: Fast live-fork microVM sandboxes for agents & RL.
anti_bot.note: not offered: no stealth/fingerprinting claims anywhere; product is a general microVM sandbox/RL platform, not a scraping/anti-bot tool.

captcha_solving.quote: Fast live-fork microVM sandboxes for agents & RL.
captcha_solving.note: not offered: outside the product's scope (microVM sandbox + RL rollout infra, not a CAPTCHA-solving service).

egress_ip_type.quote: Collimate applies an egress policy per sandbox ... sandbox egress to the cloud metadata endpoint (169.254.169.254) is blocked.
egress_ip_type.note: No residential/mobile IP product is documented; outbound traffic runs from the provider's cloud fleet (standard datacenter egress) behind a per-sandbox host allowlist.

ssh.quote: exec-in-guest ... you hand it a command ... connect-from-outside ... The SDK gives you a signed, per-sandbox URL to a port inside the guest.
ssh.note: not offered: the two documented access models are the exec API and a signed connect-url/websocket tunnel to an exposed port (browser/CDP, DB, model server); no SSH endpoint or SSH key mechanism is documented.

wake_on_request.quote: suspend — POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/suspend snapshots the sandbox to disk, reclaims its RAM, and stops the meter. resume — POST /v1/sandboxes/{id}/resume restores a suspended sandbox back to running.
wake_on_request.note: Resuming a suspended sandbox requires an explicit resume API call; no mechanism wakes a suspended sandbox automatically when an inbound request arrives.

persistent_disk.quote: Suspend freezes a running sandbox to disk: its running guest process is snapshotted, its RAM is reclaimed, and its network is released — but the sandbox is fully resumable by id.
persistent_disk.note: Suspend/resume is the stop/start analogue here and preserves the full filesystem (and memory) state, billed as snapshot storage while suspended.

volume_attach.quote: Files: byte-exact upload/download over the exec channel.
volume_attach.note: not offered: storage is the sandbox's own disk (persisted via suspend snapshots); no separate attachable/detachable volume resource is documented.

volume_shared.quote: Log in inside the rollout on first use and persist Playwright's storage_state to the fork's own disk (per-fork, never shared), so later steps in the same episode reuse the session.
volume_shared.note: Storage is explicitly per-sandbox/per-fork and never shared between concurrently running sandboxes.

auto_stop_idle.quote: Session duration — a sandbox that outlives your tier's max session is reaped. Persist anything you need and re-create, or suspend before the cap.
auto_stop_idle.note: Only a hard per-tier session-duration cap (reap) exists; there is no documented idle-based auto-suspend, and suspend is described as an explicit API call, not an automatic idle trigger.

live_resize.quote: vCPU $0.040 / vCPU-hour, billed per second while running. Memory $0.012 / GB-hour, billed per second while running.
live_resize.note: not offered: sandbox size is fixed by the template it was created/forked from; the API has no vCPU/RAM parameter and no resize endpoint is documented.

agent_harnesses.quote: python Python 3 ... node Node.js ... browser A headful browser driven over CDP. python-ml Python...
agent_harnesses.note: The template catalog is language/runtime templates (python, node, browser, python-ml), not preinstalled coding-agent harnesses (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, etc.).

own_agent_api.quote: One engine, two audiences (agentic API/MCP, and the collimate-rl SDK for rollouts).
own_agent_api.note: not offered: outside the product's scope — Collimate ships sandbox/fork infrastructure that outside agents (Claude Code, custom RL loops) drive; it does not ship its own browsing/computer-use/research agent.

public_ipv4.quote: the address is a platform-managed endpoint on api.collimate.ai. Available on Pro connect_url / cdp_url and browser egress are Pro capabilities.
public_ipv4.note: Inbound reachability is only via a signed, time-boxed connect-url/websocket tunnel to one exposed port on the shared platform domain; no per-sandbox public IPv4 is documented.

egress_http_rules.quote: egress policy resolves in this order, most specific wins ... { "egress": { "allow": ["api.github.com", "pypi.org"] } }
egress_http_rules.note: Egress control is a host allowlist (per-sandbox/per-exec/per-fork), not HTTP method/path-level rules.

secret_proxy.quote: store it in Collimate's secret store and inject it at sandbox-create time, where it reaches the sandbox through the sealed credential proxy — never the artifact, never a log.
secret_proxy.note: This is a secret store that delivers/injects the credential into the sandbox at create time (so it isn't baked into a shared image/log) — the secret still enters the guest, unlike a proxy that keeps the secret out of the machine entirely for arbitrary HTTP APIs.

static_egress_ip.note: Egress is controlled by a destination-hostname allowlist; no fixed/static outbound IP feature is documented.

gpu.quote: vCPU $0.040 / hr · RAM $0.012 / GB-hr · suspended storage $0.10 / GB-mo · spawning and forking free.
gpu.note: Only vCPU and RAM are metered/priced; no GPU instance type or GPU pricing is mentioned anywhere on the pricing or docs pages.

open_source.note: The GitHub org link surfaced on the docs site (collimate-ai/collimate) resolves to GitHub's 404 page; no public OSS repository or license for the core platform was found. Collimate is a closed-source hosted SaaS.

max_session_h.quote: Max session duration 1 hour 24 hours unlimited
max_session_h.note: Demo caps at 1h, Pro ('most teams') at 24h, Enterprise is uncapped/unlimited per the API. 24h (Pro) given as the representative value.
